notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Warchanter Skald.
An additional creature on the battlefield that will die when dealt 1 damage.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Warchanter Skald's ability from Thornbite Staff by paying {2} and tapping it, targeting a creature that would be dealt lethal damage.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating two 2/1 Dwarf tokens.
Magda, Brazen Outlaw triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Warchanter Skald's ability, dealing lethal damage to a creatrure.
Warchanter Skald's other ability from Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping it.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
